OBJECTIVES
w Set up a Function Generator for normal operation.
w Adjust a Function Generator for various output signals.
. The experiment in this lesson is not setup to use the selected trainer.
EQUIPMENT REQUIRED
Definition
Function Generators produce AC signals of various types that are used as known inputs to circuits.

In this lesson, you will set up a Function Generator to produce various output signals and then modulate the output signal.
The Nida Model 440 Function Generator is used in this lesson.
If a different model is used, the procedures are still valid. Most Function Generators are identical in operation, only the location and names of the controls may be different.

MODULATION - Set the Function to then to .

MODULATION CONTROLS - Set the Modulation to AM.
